approach: Write one design document, docs/design/scope-guard.md, with sections: purpose and mapping (Artemis with Demeter's cost view, confirmed against the BRIEF.md pantheon table rows for Artemis "Boundaries", Hestia "Continuity", Demeter "Sustainability"); value-versus-cost test with a decision rule; thrash signals with thresholds; rules versus model; powers and channels; protecting learnings work; relations to the steward, Hestia and job-planning.md section 9; a measurement and keep/turn-off rule; a numbered build plan of producer-sized jobs; risks and open questions. Add D127 (proposed) after D126 in docs/decisions.md in the D126 format, and an Unreleased "Added" CHANGELOG line. No code, no config.

decisions.choice: Confirm the operator's mapping: Artemis (Boundaries: scope and impact beyond the request) owns the role, Demeter (Sustainability: cost of operating) supplies the cost side of the test, Hestia stays knowledge and does not gate work.
decisions.reason: BRIEF.md lines 603-607 define Artemis as controlling scope and Demeter as evaluating resource consumption; the relay note at line 1067 proposes exactly this. One named role with a cost input avoids two gates.

rejected.why: Cost alone would cut cheap but pointless work and would not catch scope growth or thrash that is about repeated rejection rather than dollars.
Hestia keeps knowledge and quality; gating on her would blur learnings capture with learnings throttling.

decisions.choice: Hybrid decision: numeric rules in code decide the thrash signals and the stop/merge/defer triggers; a model only scores value inputs (failure class, need served, frequency) and writes a recommendation, and may only tighten toward 'ask Sri', never override a rule or lift a rule-based stop.
decisions.reason: Thresholds on counts, dollars and repeats are checkable and cheap; value sourcing needs reading text. Keeping the model advisory bounds its own cost and error.

rejected.why: Costs per call, non-reproducible, and could rabbit-hole itself.
Cannot tell whether a request serves a failure class or is already done or superseded.

decisions.choice: Protect learnings work by a quota (reserved share of dispatch/budget, estimate to be tuned), default-to-proceed when the value test is inconclusive, and an appeal to Sri through the existing steward channel.
decisions.reason: The BRIEF.md addendum of 2026-10-25 says learnings must flow back; the guard must cut unnecessary work, not learning.

rejected.option: Exempt all learnings work from the test
rejected.why: Learnings work can itself rabbit-hole; it needs thrash watching, only not value-blocking.

decisions.choice: Autonomous powers limited to: hold a request in queue as deferred, merge exact duplicates or done/superseded requests as proposals marked with evidence, and pause (not kill) a running line after a thrash signal; dropping, re-scoping, and anything touching governance goes to Sri.
decisions.reason: Matches the out-of-scope fact that closing the 49 open requests is not done here, and keeps destructive acts reversible.

rejected.why: Irreversible loss of intent; the request record is the user's.

decisions.choice: Thresholds seeded from the record where it supports them and labeled 'estimate, to be tuned' otherwise: e.g. 2 rejections for the same unmet criterion pauses the line; cost over forecast p90 flags; plan growth over a stated factor between rounds flags; 3 attempts or $5 on one request flags. Replay on trailer job (3 rejections, ~$11), test-suite speedup (3 rejections, ~$9, same unmet time target) and prompt-budget trap (~80 min).
decisions.reason: Acceptance requires numeric thresholds and showing which signals fire; the request-supplied figures show that two same-criterion rejections would have fired before the third speedup attempt.

rejected.why: The speedup attempts were each cheap (~$3) yet repeated an unmeasured target; a repeat-criterion signal is needed.

decisions.choice: Record figures from records/ as 'supplied by the request' because records are not visible to the producer; cite D126 and CHANGELOG for the speedup repository source (651 s to 392 s summed binary time; check 12 to 7.4-7.8 min is request-supplied).
decisions.reason: Evidence default: numbers measured, sourced or labeled.

files.purpose: The scope-guard design: mapping, value-versus-cost test, thrash signals with replay, rules versus model, powers, learnings protection, relations, measurement, build plan.
Append D127 (proposed) after D126 in the existing format, linking the design.
Add an Unreleased/Added entry naming the design and proposed D127.

steps: Re-read BRIEF.md lines 600-610 and 1060-1070 for the pantheon rows and the relay note; also roles-and-ladder.md sections on the steward and job-planning.md section 9 for the keep-rule form.
Check the last decision heading in docs/decisions.md is D126 and grep xtask/tests and crates/*/tests for any docs inventory or decisions-numbering check.

Write docs/design/scope-guard.md: purpose, mapping, grounding in the record (labeled figures), value-versus-cost test and decision table, thrash signals with thresholds and the replay on the three named cases, rules versus model, powers and channels, learnings protection, relations, measurement and keep rule, risks, numbered build plan, open questions.
Append D127 (proposed) after D126 with Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance, linking the design.
Add an Unreleased/Added line in CHANGELOG.md naming the design and D127 (proposed).
Run cargo fmt --all --check and cargo test --locked; fix any scan failures.

risks.risk: Producer invents figures not in the request or repository.
risks.mitigation: Every number carries a label: request-supplied, repository source (D126, CHANGELOG), or estimate.

risks.risk: Banned-word or personal-data scan fails on the new doc.
risks.mitigation: Avoid naming the operator or host machine and write no email-like text; run cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Decision numbering or format drift (D127 collides or deviates).
risks.mitigation: Confirm D126 is the last heading before appending and copy the D126 field layout, marking status proposed.

risks.risk: Document grows too large for one run or turns into code.
risks.mitigation: Keep to tables and prose; build-plan jobs describe scope only, no code.

risks.risk: Guard design itself becomes a rabbit hole or blocks learnings.
risks.mitigation: Default-to-proceed, protected quota, appeal path, and the guard's own keep rule modeled on job-planning.md section 9.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of docs/design/scope-guard.md section 'Value versus cost'.
demonstrations.observes: Value inputs (failure class, goal/need, frequency) each with a source field; cost inputs (dollars, wall time) each labeled measured or estimate; a decision table mapping outcomes to queue, merge, defer, drop.

demonstrations.method: Read the 'Grounding in the record' section.
demonstrations.observes: All listed figures present (trailer ~$11 and 3 rejections; ~80 min prompt-budget trap; 49 open requests; speedup jobs eebk, xgk9, y179, ~$9 and 4 h, 12 to 7.4-7.8 min, ph40; cut A four tries) each labeled request-supplied or citing D126/CHANGELOG.

demonstrations.method: Read the thrash signals table and the replay table.
demonstrations.observes: Each signal (retries, plan growth, cost vs forecast p90, same-criterion rejected twice) has a number and a basis or 'estimate, to be tuned'; the replay lists which signals fire on trailer, speedup and prompt-budget trap, and at which attempt.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the same-criterion signal the speedup replay would show no firing before the third rejection; the table must show it firing at the second.

demonstrations.observes: A list of what code decides, what the model scores, why, and an explicit list of what a model verdict may not override (rule stops, Sri-only items, quota, protected governance files).

demonstrations.method: Read the 'Powers' section and the learnings protection subsection.
demonstrations.observes: Three lists (own authority, advisory, to Sri with the channel), plus quota, default-to-proceed and appeal path tied to the BRIEF.md addendum of 2026-10-25.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the quota, default-to-proceed or appeal were absent, the section would let the guard block learnings work; each must be present.

demonstrations.observes: Steward (docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md), Hestia, and job-planning.md section 9 keep rule each treated; mapping confirmed with reasons citing the BRIEF.md pantheon table rows.

Numbered jobs ordered by dependency (e.g. record schema and signals as pure functions; replay test on named cases; queue-time value check; running-line watcher; model scorer; Sri channel and quota; measurement), each with scope, files and an acceptance check; no code in the diff.

demonstrations.method: Read the added D127 block after D126 and the CHANGELOG Unreleased entry.
demonstrations.observes: D127 titled and marked proposed with Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance, linking docs/design/scope-guard.md; CHANGELOG Unreleased has an Added line naming the design and D127.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo test --locked and cargo fmt --all --check; both pass (docs-only change).
demonstrations.observes: Exit 0 for both, including policy.rs boundary and personal-data scans over the new file.
demonstrations.fails_without: A banned word or email-like text in the new doc would fail the policy scan test.

open_questions: Exact current number of open requests and which are done or superseded cannot be read (records/ absent); the 49 figure stays request-supplied.
Whether xtask policy tests inventory docs/design files was not fully read; the producer should grep xtask/tests/policy.rs and crates/*/tests for a docs list before finishing.
Quota share and thresholds have no measurement beyond the request's record; labeled estimates.
Whether the steward or a new thread hosts the guard is left to the design; plan proposes a separate rules-first check called by the steward and queue/dispatch.
